whatIs.title: What is the national Youth Rent Support program?
whatIs.description: A national program providing up to ₩200K of actual rent per payment, with a lifetime limit of 24 payments (up to ₩4.8M before prior payments). Payments already received are deducted. Seoul’s 12-month program is separate.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Read the notice that 2026 national applications have closed.
Enter age, living and ownership status, assessed income and assets.
Enter actual rent and deposit, then select 0–24 previous national payments.
Select Check Eligibility to see 8 basic checks and a total based on remaining payments.
Verify household composition, assets, deductions, overlapping benefits and application timing through official review.

tips.title: Useful Tips
items: Only actual rent is supported; deposits and management fees are excluded from monthly payments.
Deduct previous payments from the lifetime limit of 24. After 12 payments, up to 12 remain.
Payments for new 2026 recipients end in December 2028; unused installments are not paid automatically.
Original-household income has age-30 and marriage exemptions. Check omitted criteria, including the ₩470M original-household asset ceiling.
Rent/deposit caps have been removed, but contracts, payment evidence and asset review are still required.

items.q: Can I reapply after receiving support?
items.a: Previous national payments are deducted from the lifetime limit of 24. Round 1 recipients check remaining payments; round 2 recipients may apply after their program ends. The 2026 intake is closed. Reapplication requires an official period and reassessment.

They are separate. The national program allows up to 24 lifetime payments; Seoul’s own program allows up to 12 months. Check each official notice for applications, eligibility and overlapping benefits.

items.q: Does a positive estimate mean I can apply now?
items.a: No. The 2026 national intake closed on May 29 at 16:00 Korea time. Passing basic checks does not mean official selection or an open application period.

items.q: What if I have not received 24 payments by 2028?
items.a: You may reapply in regular periods from 2029. Remaining unpaid installments may resume after reassessment of income and assets and selection.

policy.applicationWindow: Applications ran from March 30, 2026 at 09:00 to May 29 at 16:00 (Korea time) and have closed. Check official notices for the next application period.
policy.paymentWindow: New 2026 recipients receive payments only through December 2028. Unpaid remaining installments may resume after reapplication, reassessment and selection in regular periods from 2029. The estimated total is a ceiling based on remaining payments.
policy.secondRound: The lifetime limit is 24 payments across both rounds. Round 1 payments are deducted; round 2 recipients may apply after that program ends in December 2027.
policy.seoulDifference: Seoul’s own Youth Rent Support (up to 12 months) is a separate program. This calculator uses the national 24-payment rule. Eligibility, application and overlapping-benefit rules differ.
